modules.title: Performance & calibration
modules.finding: At the declared operating threshold 0.8, FPR is 0.0231 (max 0.01) and detection rate is 0.9812 (min 0.95) on 99,812 benign and 99,945 malicious held-out rows; the hard gate fails.

checks.name: fpr
checks.description: false-positive rate on benign eval rows at the operating threshold

checks.name: detection_rate
checks.description: detection rate on malicious eval rows at the operating threshold

notes: 1,204 training-manifest members were excluded from the evaluation sets.
Challenge split (informational, not gated): detection rate 0.612 on 6,315 evasive samples.

modules.title: Temporal drift
modules.finding: Sample-weighted AUT(F1) over 12 monthly windows after the 2023-12-31 cutoff is 0.803 (min 0.7); F1 falls from 0.937 to 0.665.
notes: Windows with fewer than 200 samples or a missing class are dropped and listed under details.

modules.title: Membership inference
modules.finding: Worst-case membership advantage is 0.062 (max 0.10) across 3 black-box attacks on 5,000 time-matched members and 5,000 non-members.

checks.name: advantage
checks.description: worst-case membership advantage (TPR − FPR) over attacks

notes: Non-members are time-matched to members by month and label, so distribution shift does not inflate the advantage.

modules.title: Backdoor / poisoning screen
modules.finding: The static scan flagged 2 of 48,113 root→leaf paths as backdoor-like (top suspicion 0.83); no operator trigger hypotheses were supplied.

details.art_poisoning_detectors: not applicable: ART's activation/spectral defences target neural networks, not tree ensembles

notes: Absence of findings is not proof that the model is backdoor-free; certification needs training-time access.
